o1: Enables calmodulin binding activity; enables protein kinase binding activity; and enables actin-dependent ATPase activity; predicted to enable actin filament binding. Involved in asymmetric protein localization involved in cell fate determination; polarity specification of anterior/posterior axis; positive regulation of nematode male tail tip morphogenesis; actomyosin-based contractile ring assembly; embryonic body elongation; cortical actomyosin flow; and cytokinesis. Located in the cell cortex; cleavage furrow; contractile ring; and mitotic spindle. Is expressed in QR.a; hypodermal cell; nervous system; neuroblasts; reproductive system; and lateral epidermal cells. Is part of the let-502/Rho-binding kinase and mel-11/myosin phosphatase pathway. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including auditory system disease (multiple); autosomal dominant Alport syndrome; blood platelet disease (multiple); end stage renal disease; and megacystis-microcolon-intestinal hypoperistalsis syndrome. Orthologous to human MYH10 (myosin heavy chain 10); MYH11 (myosin heavy chain 11); and MYH9 (myosin heavy chain 9).
